title: Theater work at the Palace; the Lyric
summary: He never played parades or concert bands but did stage shows at the Palace; Robichaux and Kid Punch had been at the Lyric.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you say you never played any parades then at all? I never played on parades. Any other brass bands that you played, like any concert brass bands or anything else that you worked in? No, I never played on concert bands.
Just dance bands and theater. I played a lot of theater work during the time I had the stage shows at the Palace Theater. I played a lot of stage shows. You see, where was the palace?
The palace was at Dauphin and Iberville.
Oh yeah, sure, that's the one that was still there. Still there.
The lyric was up there as well. The lyric was up there as well. The lyric was up there as well. The next column.
That's where I was. The stage shows at the palace too. The palace too. But just before my time, the professor Robichaux was at the lyric.
The lyrics. The lyrics. Yeah, we heard about them.
Several people told us about that. Kid Punch and all of them. They were playing the lyrics at that time.
Did you ever play with Punch before? I never played with him.
